name: Adaptable Performer
text:
Your broad repertoire of instruments and performances allows you to showcase many different styles, provided you have time to rehearse beforehand. As part of your daily preparations, you can select a second specialty from Virtuosic Performer. You gain the benefits of Virtuosic Performer for the selected specialty until you select a different specialty.

Additionally, whenever you perform with the bonus from Virtuosic Performer, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level that last for 1 round.
